scope: Sixteen original normalized windows through one promoted Vulkan/two-thread/blocking/passive native child, compared exactly to closed Flash B PCM. All valid and padded frames retained. Handled signals unwind owned resources; forced termination still requires caller cleanup of the reported private spool/group.
